title: Couples share their biggest money disagreements
summary: BBC Business explores common financial disputes among couples in London, examining how everyday items and major purchases create relationship tensions. The article highlights the wide range of spending disagreements that couples face, from minor expenses to significant purchases.
content: Candles, haircuts, a Tesla... this week we're asking couples in London: "What's the biggest money disagreement in your relationship?"

zh.title: 伴侣分享他们最大的金钱分歧
zh.summary: BBC商业频道探讨了伦敦情侣之间常见的财务纠纷,研究日常开支和重大购买如何造成关系紧张。该文章强调了情侣面临的广泛支出分歧,从日常小额开支到重大购买。

title: The town whose council wants migrants to move in
summary: Greenock's local council is actively pursuing immigration as a strategy to combat population decline and revitalize the struggling Scottish town. The initiative reflects growing recognition that immigration could address demographic challenges in declining communities.
content: Greenock wants to attract immigrants to settle in the town and reverse its declining population.

zh.title: 想要移民搬入的城镇议会
zh.summary: 格里诺克的地方议会正在积极推行移民战略,以对抗人口下降并重振这个苦苦挣扎的苏格兰城镇。该倡议反映了人们日益认识到移民可以解决衰退社区的人口挑战。

title: 'Perfect storm' brews for global food supply this winter as grain prices soar
summary: Global food supply faces mounting pressure as wheat prices surge due to concerns about crop yields and upcoming planting challenges. The convergence of these factors threatens food security and prices heading into winter.
content: Fears over crop yields and farmers' ability to plant ahead of next year have come to the fore as wheat prices jump.

zh.title: 谷物价格飙升,全球食品供应冬季面临"完美风暴"
zh.summary: 由于对作物产量和即将进行的种植工作的担忧,小麦价格飙升,全球食品供应面临越来越大的压力。这些因素的汇合威胁到了冬季前的粮食安全和价格。

title: 'A delicate dance': JD Vance says economic pressure is the best way to achieve Washington's objectives in Iran
summary: U.S. Vice President JD Vance advocates for economic pressure as the primary tool for achieving American policy goals in Iran. Vance suggests recent weeks show Iran experiencing greater economic strain than the U.S.
content: Vance said "what has been true over the last couple of weeks is they felt a lot more pressure than we have."

zh.title: "微妙的舞蹈"：范斯说经济压力是实现华盛顿对伊朗目标的最佳方式
zh.summary: 美国副总统范斯倡导将经济压力作为实现美国对伊朗政策目标的主要工具。范斯表示，最近几周显示伊朗经历的经济压力大于美国。

title: Taiwan's AI-fueled forecast of 11% GDP growth likely not sustainable, economists say
summary: Economists question the sustainability of Taiwan's 11% GDP growth forecast driven by AI, citing vulnerability to semiconductor capex slowdowns and macroeconomic risks. The island's economic concentration in a single sector leaves it exposed to significant downside risks.
content: Taiwan's economic growth could moderate due to its vulnerability to risks of capex slowdown, macroeconomic downturns, and concentration in semiconductors.

zh.title: 经济学家表示，台湾的人工智能推动的11%GDP增长预测可能不可持续
zh.summary: 经济学家质疑台湾由人工智能驱动的11%GDP增长预测的可持续性，理由是容易受到半导体资本支出放缓和宏观经济风险的影响。该岛经济集中在单一部门，使其面临重大下行风险。

title: U.S. bond intervention is like 'paying your mortgage with your credit card,' JPMorgan's Sullivan says
summary: JPMorgan strategist James Sullivan compares Treasury market interventions to short-term debt solutions, warning they merely defer rather than resolve underlying fiscal problems. The assessment suggests current government actions risk exacerbating long-term economic pressures.
content: The U.S. government's efforts to manage pressure in the Treasury market risk merely shifting the problem down the road, according to JPMorgan's James Sullivan.

zh.title: 摩根大通的沙利文说，美国债券干预就像"用信用卡支付抵押贷款"
zh.summary: 摩根大通策略师詹姆斯·沙利文将国债市场干预比作短期债务解决方案，警告它们只是延迟而不是解决潜在的财政问题。该评估表明，当前政府行动有风险加剧长期经济压力。

title: Chinese humanoid robots' biggest obstacle: humans are still (mostly) better
summary: Despite advances in robotics, Chinese humanoid robots continue to lag behind human performance in most practical work applications. The persistent efficiency gap highlights the technological challenges remaining in automating complex labor tasks.
content: Humanoid robots still struggle to perform as efficiently as humans in most labor scenarios.

zh.title: 中国类人机器人最大的障碍：人类仍然（大多数情况下）更优秀
zh.summary: 尽管机器人技术进步，中国类人机器人在大多数实际工作应用中仍然落后于人类的表现。持久的效率差距凸显了自动化复杂劳动任务中仍然存在的技术挑战。

title: Micron CEO pushes back on memory bear case. 3 key takeaways from Cramer's big interview
summary: Micron's CEO countered bearish memory chip market predictions in an interview with Jim Cramer, with analyst insights suggesting confidence in the company's outlook. The discussion provided key takeaways that strengthened conviction in Micron as an investment.
content: Jim Cramer's extended interview with the CEO made us more confident in our newest stock position.

zh.title: 美光首席执行官反驳存储芯片熊市观点 克莱默专访的3个关键要点
zh.summary: 美光首席执行官在接受吉姆·克莱默采访时反驳了对存储芯片市场的悲观预测,分析师的见解表明对公司前景充满信心。这次讨论提供了加强投资者对美光投资信心的关键要点。

title: Stock futures are little changed after a steep sell-off sparked by a move back higher in Treasury yields: Live updates
summary: Stock futures remained flat following a significant market sell-off triggered by rising Treasury yields, with the Dow falling 700 points in its worst session since late July. The persistent yield pressure indicated continued uncertainty in equity markets.
content: The Dow ended Thursday's session down 700 points, marking its worst day since July 29.

zh.title: 股指期货在美债收益率上升引发大幅抛售后基本持平:实时更新
zh.summary: 股指期货在美债收益率上升引发的大幅市场抛售后保持基本平稳,道琼斯指数下跌700点,创下自7月底以来最差表现。持续的收益率压力表明股市仍存在不确定性。

title: CFTC’s Innovation Advisory Committee meeting addresses emerging prediction market risks
summary: The CFTC convened its Innovation Advisory Committee to examine risks in prediction markets, with regulators proposing stricter consumer protections. The discussion highlighted growing concerns about unregulated prediction market growth and investor vulnerability.
content: The CFTC's first Innovation Advisory Committee meeting discussed risks of mention markets, with members advocating for tighter consumer protection.

zh.title: 美国商品期货交易委员会创新顾问委员会会议讨论新兴预测市场风险
zh.summary: 美国商品期货交易委员会召集创新顾问委员会审查预测市场风险,监管机构提出更严格的消费者保护措施。讨论凸显了对不受监管的预测市场增长和投资者风险的日益关注。

title: Japan headline inflation rate hits highest this year as energy prices bite
summary: Japan's headline inflation reached its highest level in 2026 as surging energy prices pushed consumer costs higher, though core inflation came in at 1.8% as expected. The data reflects global commodity price pressures affecting Japan's economy.
content: Core inflation — which strips out prices of fresh food but includes energy — was in line with expectations, coming in at 1.8%.

zh.title: 日本标题通胀率因能源价格上升而创今年新高
zh.summary: 随着能源价格飙升推高消费者成本，日本2026年标题通胀率达到最高水平，尽管核心通胀率如预期为1.8%。这一数据反映了全球商品价格压力对日本经济的影响。

title: Japan's historic yen intervention has ‘turbo-charged’ the carry trade
summary: Japan's central bank intervention to strengthen the yen inadvertently boosted conditions for the carry trade, where investors borrow cheap yen to invest in higher-yielding assets elsewhere. The policy move created favorable arbitrage opportunities that may intensify capital outflows from Japan.
content: Japan's historic effort to prop up the yen may have had an unintended consequence: giving investors a better opportunity to put the carry trade back on.

zh.title: 日本历史性日元干预"加速推动"套利交易
zh.summary: 日本央行加强日元的干预措施无意中促进了套利交易的有利条件，投资者借入廉价日元投资其他高收益资产。这一政策举措创造了有利的套利机会，可能会加剧日本的资本外流。
